title: Interval Bows
description: Hold to auto-charge and fire bows in intervals while preserving all native modded bow mechanics.
body:
## 🏹 Savaru Interval Bows

Savaru Interval Bows introduces an **interval-based auto charge shooting system** to Minecraft.

Instead of manually charging and releasing every shot, simply **hold right-click** to:

- Automatically play the full draw animation  
- Release a fully charged shot  
- Enter cooldown  
- Repeat continuously  

---

## 🔧 Native Bow Compatibility

This mod **does NOT replace projectile logic**.

Instead, it automatically releases the bow using its **native shooting method**, ensuring full compatibility with:

- Too Many Bows  
- Modded arrows  
- Custom bow abilities  
- Enchantments  
- Special projectile effects  

All modded bows will continue to fire their **original unique arrows and behaviors**.

---

## ✨ Features

- Hold-to-fire interval shooting  
- Native bow shooting  
- Compatible with all `UseAction.BOW` items  
- Cooldown bar after each shot  
- In-game configuration GUI  
- Prevents block mining while holding a bow  

---

## ⚙ Configuration

Press:

O


to open the config GUI in-game.

Configurable values:

- Charge Time (ticks)  
- Cooldown Time (ticks)  

Config file location:

.minecraft/config/intervalbow.json


---

## 📦 Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.1  
- Fabric Loader  

---

## ✅ Compatibility

Tested with:

- Too Many Bows

---

Continuous Archery Without Losing Native Bow Mechanics.
